desc: Introducing the DPMS CAR-15 style adjustable pistol brace. Made from durable injection molded polymer, this brace is the perfect way to finish off that retro pistol build or just add some functional style to an existing lower. Lever easily inverts to slide the brace on a 6 position mil-spec buffer tube and locks snug into place. QD point on back of brace for easy sling connection.
